purpose: Preserve every unmerged RiverShift validation source file at its exact Git blob identity. The archived workflows remain immutable source evidence only. Separate root ports for the OPERA DSWx-S1 and Run #36 replay workflows are independently reviewed, manual-only, fail-closed Monorepo Preview workflows; the archive files themselves are never activated or run on general pushes.

sources.source_commit_message: Expose RTC-S1 availability diagnostics in Actions summary

files.safety: Contains workflow_dispatch and a push trigger on a sentinel path. Archive only. If later promoted, remove push trigger, use manual dispatch, pin all actions/checkout refs and complete the workflow dry-run first.

Contains OPERA DSWx-S1 WTR reference and optional RTC-S1 inventory logic. NISAR GCOV remains primary. RTC-S1 inventory is backscatter discovery only and cannot produce water labels or agreement metrics.
Archived regression tests; not yet executed in the Monorepo path. Required dependencies and source imports must be reconciled before promotion.

sources.source_commit_message: Validate retained Run 36 replay workflow contract

files.safety: Archive only. Keep manual-only if promoted. It downloads retained artifacts and must not trigger automatically on general pushes.

Retrospective reproduction only. Output explicitly identifies RETROSPECTIVE_RECOMPUTED_NOT_ORIGINAL_WORKER_ARTIFACT; the first event-proximal NISAR acquisition was 20 days after the user-supplied event date, not event-peak evidence.

scientific_boundaries: NISAR GCOV remains the primary measurement input.
OPERA DSWx-S1 is a cross-sensor SAR-derived water reference, not field truth.
Only OPERA WTR classes 0 and 1 are labelled; inundated vegetation and masked classes remain NoData.
Independent-reference scores require the temporal and common-support gates; otherwise return NO_MATCH_NO_SCORE, never zero.
RTC-S1 backscatter inventory is not a water mask and cannot produce WTR agreement scores.
Run #36 replay is retrospective reproducibility evidence, not an original worker artifact or proof of independent geophysical accuracy.
No validation workflow from this archive is activated by normal Monorepo pushes.
promotion_gates: Resolve every runtime module/import against engines/river-shift/tools/river_shift and its declared requirements.
Run the archived unit suite in a pinned, isolated environment.
Mock CMR discovery, OPERA download receipts, checksum mismatch, mixed tracks/orbits, unknown WTR classes, no-scene and temporal-mismatch outcomes.
Remove any automatic push trigger and explicitly pin every action and external source checkout.
Dry-run artifact retrieval, HMAC callback/status, artifact retention and final failure propagation without consuming production credentials.
Keep the independent score NO_MATCH_NO_SCORE when the reference or temporal/common-support gate fails.
